name: LoadScriptEntryTable
evidence: reads a count and n1/n2 from the stream, allocates count 8-byte entries at +0x1EF4, reads one script value chain per entry, then evaluates each through EvalScriptEntry in a scope

name: GetScriptEntryScope
evidence: returns -1 as 0, else the scope stored in entry index of the table at +0x1EF4 after AddUniqueMarkRoot

name: EvalScriptEntry
evidence: for entry index of the table at +0x1EF4 creates its scope (NewScriptScope) once and evaluates the entry's chain in it with EvalScriptExpression

name: FindPropertyDescriptor
evidence: binary search for key in the sorted pair table D_00244950[class index]; returns the matching value or 0

name: BuildScriptListFromCallback
evidence: runs a callback that fills a record, then makes a script value from the chain it collected (SetScriptValueChain) or an empty one

name: ReadPropertyValue
evidence: reads a property described by a Desc record (kind, flags, offset or getter) from an object and builds the matching script value for int, float, bool, vector, matrix, pair or triple kinds

name: AppendPropertyToScriptList
evidence: reads one value of the list's kind with ReadPropertyValue into a new script value node and links it at the list's tail

name: ScriptListContainsValue
evidence: builds a script value of the command's kind from val and walks the list comparing with AreScriptValuesEqual, returning 1 on a match

name: StoreScriptArguments
evidence: for each of n script values, converts and stores it through the destination pointer of the same index according to its kind (int, float, vector, matrix, pair, triple)

name: BuildScriptListFromPairs
evidence: for n key/value pairs appends AppendPropertyToScriptList nodes with the key as kind and ends in one script value chain

name: WritePropertyValue
evidence: counterpart of ReadPropertyValue: stores a script value into a property through its field offset or setter; called by UpdateObjectProperty with the object, the descriptor from FindPropertyDescriptor and the new value

name: GetObjectProperty
evidence: keys below 0x495 go through FindPropertyDescriptor and ReadPropertyValue, other keys are looked up in the object's keyed list at +4 with FindKeyedValue

name: UpdateObjectProperty
evidence: keys below 0x495 write through FindPropertyDescriptor and WritePropertyValue, other keys call UpdateKeyedValue on the list at +4

name: AddObjectProperty
evidence: after func_00130110 calls AddKeyedValue with key and value on the list at +4

name: SetExtraObjectProperty
evidence: after func_00130110 updates the key in the object's keyed list at +4 when FindKeyedValue finds it, otherwise adds it

name: StoreScriptArgumentsVa
evidence: collects the variadic destination pointers (count of them) into an array and calls StoreScriptArguments

name: StartToSprChain
evidence: variadic (size,data) pairs become 16-byte-aligned entries and DMA tags of the current ring slot, then it kicks the to-scratchpad channel (g_toSprChannel) at the slot's tag list

name: StartFromSprChain
evidence: variadic values are written into the tags of the current ring slot, the last marked as end, then it kicks the from-scratchpad channel (g_fromSprChannel)

name: ConstructScratchpadTransfers
evidence: the file's static initialiser: on the construction pass (first argument set, second 0xFFFF) builds the two 0x50-byte scratchpad transfer records D_002748F0[0] and [1] from constant templates

name: ConstructScratchpadTransfersAtStartup
evidence: the file's _GLOBAL_$I: calls ConstructScratchpadTransfers(1, 0xFFFF); it is in the constructor list D_0027B130 (+0x34)
